title: A School Health Center Intervention to Increase Adolescent Vaccination
brief_summary: The study will evaluate a health services intervention to increase uptake of adolescent vaccines (HPV, Tdap, meningococcal conjugate, and influenza) among students enrolled in five school health centers by improving the consent process for parents.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All students enrolled at target schools
